headline: Indonesian National Police Formalizes Virtual Ethics Hearing Rules
seoTitle: Indonesian Police Virtual Ethics Hearing Rules
metaDescription: National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto introduces new regulations allowing online ethics hearings for police personnel, including Listyo Sigit.
aiSummaryBullets: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto issued new regulations enabling ethics commission hearings to be conducted via virtual platforms.
The updated policy includes new procedural guidelines for determining the composition of the ethics hearing panel.
The disciplinary proceedings concerning former Police Chief Listyo Sigit regarding alleged illegal surveillance are expected next week.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian National Police has implemented new regulations governing the conduct of the Professional Code of Ethics Commission (KKEP) hearings. Chief of Police General Suyudi Ario Seto signed the new police regulation, which officially allows for disciplinary sessions to be held online. In addition to enabling virtual participation, the policy establishes specific mechanisms for the formation and organization of the ethics panel. These developments occur as the department prepares for the upcoming ethics trial of former Chief of Police Listyo Sigit, who faces allegations linked to the reported surveillance of President Prabowo. While the internal proceedings move forward, various political figures have voiced concerns regarding the influence of individuals associated with the former chief within government institutions, urging for administrative changes to maintain security and impartiality within the current presidential administration.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by five independent media outlets with a high velocity of reporting, driven by public and political interest in the ethics investigation.
